text: BLNK. Creative Studio is a Beirut-based creative studio founded in 2014, offering Brand Identity, Digital Design, and Visual Systems services, and serving the GCC. Its tagline is "We build brands that mean business." (نبني علامات تجارية تعني الأعمال).

BLNK. specializes in brand identity, digital design, and visual systems for companies across the Gulf region that want to grow with intention and clarity. بلنك ستوديو إبداعي مقره بيروت، تأسس عام 2014، نتخصص في الهوية البصرية والتصميم الرقمي والأنظمة المرئية للشركات في منطقة الخليج.

BLNK. key facts: 10+ years active (a decade building brands across the Arab world); 50+ brands built, from startups to established institutions; GCC market focus covering Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Oman; and full bilingual (EN/AR) creative design capability.

Contact BLNK. Creative Studio: email hello@blnkcs.com, phone/WhatsApp +961 79 057 374, Instagram @blnkcstudio, website www.blnkcs.com. BLNK. invites people to reach out to start a conversation about their brand.
BLNK. Creative Studio's office at Rive Gauche Tower, Corniche El Nahr, Beirut, Lebanon is open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
BLNK. states it has worked with 20+ brands across real estate, food & beverage, finance, and entertainment, from Beirut to the Gulf, and its portfolio deck separately states 50+ brands built overall.

BLNK.'s value proposition: "We don't just design. We build brands that work." BLNK. combines strategic thinking with editorial design to create brands that are not just beautiful, but effective and built to last in the GCC market. (نجمع بين التفكير الاستراتيجي والتصميم التحريري لإنشاء علامات تجارية فعالة ومستدامة في سوق الخليج.)
BLNK. differentiator - GCC Market Expertise: BLNK. understands the visual language, cultural nuances, and business expectations of the Gulf market. (خبرة في سوق الخليج)
BLNK. differentiator - Bilingual Creative Capability: BLNK. offers full Arabic and English design from brand strategy through to final files, with zero translation gaps. (قدرة إبداعية ثنائية اللغة)
BLNK. differentiator - Strategic + Editorial Approach: BLNK. thinks before it designs; every visual decision is grounded in brand strategy and market insight. (نهج استراتيجي وتحريري)
BLNK. differentiator - Direct Creative Team Access: there are no account managers or intermediaries; clients work directly with the creative leads on their project. (تواصل مباشر مع الفريق الإبداعي)
BLNK. service - Brand Identity (الهوية البصرية), per the Company Profile: includes logo design & variations, brand books & guidelines, visual systems & naming, and brand strategy & positioning.

BLNK. service - Digital Design (التصميم الرقمي): a full web development service covering the entire journey from UI/UX design (in Figma) to delivering a fully working website — including backend development, hosting, and ongoing website management — not design-only. Also includes app interface design, digital campaign assets, and email & newsletter design.

BLNK. service - Print & Collateral (المطبوعات والمواد التسويقية), per the Company Profile: includes letterheads, envelopes, and business cards; brochures & company profiles; signage & environmental design; and packaging & product design.

BLNK. service - Social Media Design (تصميم وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي), per the Company Profile: includes reels & post templates, story formats & highlights, Canva-ready editable kits, and content calendar design.
Every BLNK. service across its four Company-Profile disciplines (Brand Identity, Digital Design, Print & Collateral, Social Media Design) is delivered bilingually, in both Arabic and English.

BLNK. project timing: just like pricing, how long a project takes depends on several factors — the scope of what's needed, which specific services are involved, and the size of the business — so there's no single fixed timeline; it's best discussed directly based on the project's specifics.

BLNK. portfolio section - Brand Identity: covers brand strategy, visual identity, and brand book & guidelines. This is the largest section of BLNK.'s portfolio, covering the majority of its showcased client projects.
BLNK. portfolio section - Websites & Apps: covers UI/UX design, web development, and app design.
BLNK. portfolio section - Social Media: covers content strategy, visual content, and community management.
BLNK. portfolio section - Events & Activations: covers event planning, brand activations, and production & execution.
BLNK. portfolio section - Photography: covers product photography, food and lifestyle photography, and editorial ad campaigns.
BLNK.'s process, phase 1 - Discover (الاستكشاف): brand audit & analysis, competitor research, stakeholder interviews, and market positioning.
BLNK.'s process, phase 2 - Define (التحديد): brand strategy, messaging framework, creative brief, and visual direction.
BLNK.'s process, phase 3 - Design (التصميم): logo concepts, visual identity system, design & feedback rounds, and final refinements.
BLNK.'s process, phase 4 - Deliver (التسليم): final files in all formats, brand book handover, implementation support, and post-launch guidance.
BLNK. describes its overall process as going "from brief to brand in four clear phases": Discover, Define, Design, and Deliver.

BLNK. Creative Studio offers a free 15-minute consultation for prospective customers, bookable online via Calendly at https://calendly.com/a-issa-blnkcs/15min.
